coverage_limitations: F48 event dispatch, nonnull F144 module handler bodies, F1907 audio, F942 fatal response and F952 equipment damage remain explicit ordered providers.
Original F144 actual table reads are supported for source event columns2 and11; unrelated event columns are outside this kernel.
Actual F1538 reads are bounded to original initialized-object model indices0..148; unused raw body model words remain opaque.
F144 event11 exposes its defined packet fields and sole body owner; uninitialized stack padding and local event11 packet writes are outside this boundary profile.
Optional event2 payload_after_u32 updates the actual shared F148 action/value stack packet; other boundary kinds reject this field.
The native observation transport caps64 callbacks,10 byte patches per callback and32 bytes per patch; public runtime complete before/after observations retain their independent context contract.
This is source-kernel parity; full F575/F569 orchestration, actual module handlers, live Main and Android behavior require separate integration.
